Business Strategy Intern — Banyan Wealth

About Banyan Wealth

Banyan Wealth builds reliable, human-centered software and analytical platforms used by teams across universities, financial institutions, and distributed engineering organizations. We value clear written communication, careful engineering, and measurable outcomes over buzzwords.

Role Overview: Business Strategy Intern

As a Business Strategy Intern at Banyan Wealth, you will collaborate with product engineers, data scientists, and operations leads to design, test, and ship production workflows. You will participate in weekly design reviews, write well-documented code and unit tests, monitor service reliability, and help improve internal developer tooling.

Requirements & Qualifications

Currently enrolled student; rolling basis intake.

Core skills for this position include PowerPoint, Excel, Market Research. Candidates should be comfortable working with version control, structured data, and collaborative code reviews.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short note describing a recent technical or analytical project. We review applications carefully and communicate updates through our official careers portal.
